# **Step-by-Step Guide: Generating SSCS Sales Reports for DABS Monthly Report**

## **Purpose**

This guide outlines how to access and generate the sales reports from the SSCS back office system that are needed for the monthly DABS (Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control) reporting.

## **Prerequisites**

* Access to SSCS back office system  
* Knowledge of the reporting date range needed

## **Steps**

### **Step 1: Access the SSCS Back Office System**

* Log into the SSCS back office system  
* Navigate to the main reports screen/menu

### **Step 2: Select Sales Reports**

* From the main reports menu, locate and select the sales reports option  
* This will take you to the sales report configuration screen

![][image1]

### **Step 3: Configure Report Parameters**

* **Set Date Range**:  
  * Enter the beginning date (start of the month you're reporting)  
  * Enter the ending date (end of the month you're reporting)  
  * Note: These dates should correlate with the specific month needed for DABS reporting

![][image2]

### **Step 4: Generate the Report**

* After setting the date parameters, execute the report by pressing View (F6)  
* The system will generate a comprehensive sales report

![][image3]

### **Step 5: Review Report Contents**

**What the report includes:**

* All items that were bought OR sold during the specified time range  
* Complete transaction data for DABS reporting requirements

**Important limitations to note:**

* **Missing data**: List price information is NOT included in this report  
* **Inventory gaps**: Items in inventory that didn't move (no purchases or sales) during the time period will NOT appear on this report

### **Step 6: Export/Extract Data**

* Press the small Icon that is at the top left of the report just right of the Printer Icon.  This will open up a prompt menu where you can email the report to [shawn@owenent.com](mailto:shawn@owenent.com) and BCC to another email address to email the report.   
* Use the system's export functionality to extract the report data  
* Save in the format required for the DABS monthly report upload template

## **Automation Benefits**

Once automated, this process will eliminate approximately **16.5+ hours of manual work per month** currently required for DABS reporting.

## **Next Steps for Automation**

The screenshots and process documentation will be used to build automation that will:

* Automatically access the correct reports  
* Set appropriate date ranges  
* Export data in the required format  
* Eliminate manual intervention in the monthly reporting process
